advancement.anime_multiverse.root.title: Multiverse of Anime
advancement.anime_multiverse.root.desc: Grimoires, relics and dungeons of many worlds. Every spell you cast and every foe you fell is written down here.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.first: Receive your grimoire, the book that will carry your magic.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.open_: Open your grimoire and read its first pages.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.cerem: Take part in the Grimoire Acceptance Ceremony and let a grimoire choose you.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.quest: Answer every question of the Tower Wizard and learn which magic is born in you.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.meet_: Speak with the wizard of a Grimoire Tower.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.first: Cast a spell from your grimoire.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.mana_: Cast twenty-five spells. Every spell costs mana, and mana refills slowly.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.casts: Cast fifty spells. Mastery comes from successful casts.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.first: Unlock a new page of your grimoire through mastery.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.pages: Unlock ten pages: a grimoire that has grown with its master.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.maste: Fill the mastery bar of a grimoire completely.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.magic: Pick up a magic stone, the dungeon's currency.
advancement.anime_multiverse.start.five_: Receive five grimoires over your journeys.

advancement.anime_multiverse.dungeon.meg: The Mega-Dungeon
Enter the Mega-Dungeon, one endless dungeon that grows every time a sector guardian falls.
Through the Gateway
Step through a Gateway into the Mega-Dungeon.
A Safe Seat
Rest at a seat, a hearth or a bed in a safe zone. Nothing else heals you down here.
Hide and Seek
Get away from a wandering boss without dying.
Sector Cleared
Defeat the Labyrinth Guardian of a sector.
Three Sectors Deep
Clear three sectors of the Mega-Dungeon.
The Crucible of Choice
Take a relic from a Crucible. Only one can be taken, and the dungeon answers.
Floor 0
Arrive in the Sanctuary Hub: a safe place to build, and the start of both roads.
The Holy Road
Clear the first floor of the Holy road. From now on the Abyssal road is closed to you.
The Abyssal Road
Clear the first floor of the Abyssal road. From now on the Holy road is closed to you.
Ten Floors
Reach floor +10 or floor -10 of the Mega-Dungeon.
The System
Finish a quest that the System gives you on a Holy floor.
Arise
Extract the shadow of a defeated Holy enemy with a Shadow Core.
Standard Issue
Find a graded piece of standard gear in the Mega-Dungeon.
Rare Grade
Find a Rare-grade piece of standard gear, made to turn magic aside.
